description: NaGaH₄ is Zircon-like structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmcm space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight H¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.55 Å. Ga³⁺ is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four H¹⁻ atoms. There are two shorter (1.58 Å) and two longer (1.59 Å) Ga-H bond lengths. There are two inequivalent H¹⁻ sites. In the first H¹⁻ site, H¹⁻ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and one Ga³⁺ atom. In the second H¹⁻ site, H¹⁻ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and one Ga³⁺ atom.
